description: Today the Washington State Farm Bureau announced it has endorsed Drew Stokesbary's campaign for the State House of Representatives. The decision by the Farm Bureau Board of Trustees followed the recommendation of the King-Pierce County Farm Bureau, and was based on Stokesbary's understanding and support of the agricultural community and Farm Bureau policies.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Drew Stokesbary (R)
title: Washington State Farm Bureau endorses Stokesbary - Re-Elect Drew Stokesbary
